hits.snippet: # Olipop prepares for growth with new CEO olipop.jpg Ben Goodwin, left, is transitioning from founder and chief executive officer of Olipop to chairman and head of innovation. Christian Patiño Webb has been named the company’s new CEO. | Photo: Olipop 08.12.2026 By Brooke Just [Google Add as a preferred source on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=foodbusinessnews.net&location=article_header) OAKLAND, CALIF. — Functional soda company Olipop has named Christian Patiño Webb as its new chief executive officer to support its next stage of growth. Patiño Webb succeeds Ben Goodwin, founder and CEO, who is transitioning to executive chairman and head of innovation for the company. Goodwin, who founded the company in 2018 to support digestive health, will focus on the company’s long-term vision, advance innovation and also shape its next phase of growth while also stewarding its mission, values and culture and will work in partnership with Patiño Webb. Patiño Webb comes to Olipop from Electrolit, where he most recently was CEO.
